text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "postLinks.PostId semantically references a post (the posts table), while postHistory.Id is the primary key of individual revision-history entries — postHistory even has its own PostId column for the real post reference — so the 0.858 containment is just chance overlap of dense integer ID ranges (target Ids run 1–386,848 covering the source's 4–115,360 range, with only 2.2% coverage), and a many-to-one link from post links to single history entries makes no real-world sense."}
